y-m-67-09.title: ∫ x ln x dx yakagadziriswa nenzira mbiri
y-m-67-09.topic: Nzira dzekuita integration: kuenzanisa nzira mbiri dzeintegration by parts
y-m-67-09.goal: Simbisa kuti kureba kwekuverenga kunogona kusiyana zvichienderana nekuti unosarudza sei u ne v′ mu integration by parts, uye kuti kunyange nzira inoita sekundikana inopa mugumisiro mumwe chete kana yapfupiswa, uye unyore chikonzero chesarudzo yako.
y-m-67-09.material: Vadzidzi vaviri vanoedza kuwana indefinite integral ∫ x ln x dx (x>0; inoverengwa: integral ye x nguva natural logarithm ye x, ne x) neintegration by parts, ∫u v′ dx = uv − ∫u′ v dx. Jihu anoita u = ln x ne v′ = x, uye Haeun anoita u = x ne v′ = ln x. (Fungidzira kuti watoziva kuti indefinite integral ye ln x i x ln x − x. Constant yeintegration inonyorwa C.)

y-m-67-09.s.s1.prompt: Usati watanga kuverenga, kufungidzira kupi kunokodzera zvikuru nezvenzira mbiri?
y-m-67-09.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora u′ ne v kune nzira imwe neimwe yemaviri uye uenzanise kuti ipi iri nyore.
y-m-67-09.s.s1.hint.1: Kunzira yaHaeun, nyora zvaunofanira kuita integrate kuwana v.
y-m-67-09.s.s1.o.a: Nzira yaJihu inoita sekuti iri nyore. Kutora derivative ye ln x kunopa 1/x iri nyore.
y-m-67-09.s.s1.r.a: Wakaenzanisa mutengo wekuwana u′ ne v pamwe chete.
y-m-67-09.s.s1.o.b: Nzira yaHaeun iri nyore. Izvi nokuti kutora derivative ye u = x kunopa constant 1.
y-m-67-09.s.s1.r.b: Wakatarisa divi umo u′ iri nyore chete uye hauna kufunga basa rinodiwa kuwana v (kuita integrate ye ln x).
y-m-67-09.s.s1.o.c: Handigoni kusarudza kuti nzira ipi yemaviri iri nyore usati waverenga.
y-m-67-09.s.s1.r.c: Izvi zvinomisa kutonga usati waedza. Unogona kumisa, asi kuti uenzanise unofanira kuita kufungidzira.
y-m-67-09.s.s1.explain: Unogona kufungidzira kuti sarudzo yaJihu ichava pfupi, sezvo kutora derivative ye u kunoita kuti ive nyore (1/x) uye v′=x inogona kuitwa integrate pakarepo. Asi izvi hazvireve kuti sarudzo yaHaeun haigoneki.
y-m-67-09.s.s1.acc.0: Zvinogoneka kumisa kutonga usati waverenga, asi kuita kufungidzira nekuriongorora nekuverenga kunobatsira kuenzanisa.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.prompt: Haeun akaverenga ne u = x ne v = x ln x − x, ndokuwana I = ∫ x ln x dx = x(x ln x − x) − ∫(x ln x − x) dx = x² ln x − x² − I + x²/2. I inoonekwa zvakare kudivi rekurudyi. Chii chinoitika kunzira iyi?
y-m-67-09.s.s2.hint.0: Edza kutora I sechisingazivikanwi uone kana unogona kurongedza equation ine I kumativi ose maviri.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.hint.1: Tora derivative yemugumisiro wawakawana uye uongorore kana ichidzoka ku x ln x.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.o.a: I inoonekwa zvakare, saka nzira iyi haigoni kugadzirisa.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.r.a: Izvi zvakatora integral imwe chete ichiwonekazve sokutadza pakarepo. Tarisa kana unogona kuona chirevo chose sechirevo che I.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.o.b: I yakaonekazve, saka kukanganisa kwokuverenga uye ndinofanira kutangazve.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.r.b: I ichiwonekazve nokukanganisa kwokuverenga zvakasiyana. Wakasimbirira kuti kukanganisa usina kutarisa kana mitsetse yapfuura yakarurama.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.o.c: Kana ukarongedza zvakare sechirevo che I, unowana mhedzisiro imwe chete naJihu.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.r.c: Wakaona chirevo che I kumativi ose mbiri sechirevo chimwe chete.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.explain: Kuenzanisa x² ln x − x²/2 − I na I kunopa 2I = x² ln x − x²/2, saka I = (x²/2) ln x − x²/4 + C. Mhedzisiro yaJihu yakafanana. Kusiyanisa chirevo chawakawana kunopa x ln x.
y-m-67-09.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza nzira ipi yaungashandisa padambudziko iri, uye unyore kuti mhedzisiro dzenzira mbiri idzi dzakafanana (kana dzakasiyana) sei nechikonzero chako chokuisarudza.

y-m-67-10.s.s3.prompt: Pane robhoti ine kukurumidza v(t) = t − c (c>0). Sarudza mapeya 3 akasiyana (c, b) umo displacement kubva pa 0 masekonzi kusvika pa b masekonzi iri 0. (c ne b dziri pamusoro; madhesimali anobvumirwa.)

y-m-67-05.s.s1.o.c: h haisi 0, saka tebhura haina musoro, uye tinofanira kuvimba nefomula yakayeukwa.
y-m-67-05.s.s1.r.c: Derivative i mutengo chaiwo kana h ichiswedera ku 0. Tebhura i humbowo hunoenda kumutengo uyu.
y-m-67-05.s.s1.explain: Kunyange kana h yaderedzwa, mutengo unoungana padyo ne 0.693, kwete 0. Saka pa x=0, fomula yaSubin x·aˣ⁻¹ = 0 haienderani ne slope ye tangent line kune a=2.
